set system host-name client001.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set system services ssh root-login allow.command: set system services ssh root-login allow
set system services ssh root-login allow.explanation: Allows root users to log in via SSH.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Controls whether root users can access through SSH.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Sets the protocol version for SSH services.

set system login user <username> class s.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication [parameter3]
set system login user <username> class s.command: set system login user <username> class super-user authentication plain-text-password
set system login user <username> class s.explanation: Configure system login users, set user categories and authentication methods.

set system login user <username> full-na.template: set system login user [username] full-name "[full name]"
set system login user <username> full-na.command: set system login user <username> full-name "<full name>"
set system login user <username> full-na.explanation: Configure a user's full name in the system login settings

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: The username for which the full name is being set

parameters.name: full name
parameters.explanation: The full name to be associated with the username

set system services ssh connection-limit.explanation: Sets the connection limits for SSH services.

parameters.name: connection-limit
parameters.explanation: Maximum number of connections to SSH services.
